ABOUT US
THE WYCLIFFE GUEST HOUSE
You are assured of a warm welcome at our Victorian guest house situated in its own gardens, one of the very few in the area with private off road parking.
Over the years the charming building has been tastefully modernised to provide clean and comfortable accommodation whilst still retaining many of its original features.

About Us
-->
The Wycliffe is family owned guest house who offer a warm and hospitable welcome to all guests whether staying for a short break or looking for longer term residence whilst working in the area. We are on hand to assist with information on local eateries and places of interest in the area. Book your place now at our accommodation in Kent .
We are fully compliant with the requirements of the Food Standards Agency, the Health and Safety Executive, Kent Fire Service, local and national government and insurance agencies. We are still committed to being inspected by recognised Quality Standard agencies but are also self-rating ourselves based on customer feedback.
In line with Government requirements we operate a non smoking policy throughout the building; we do however have facilities to accommodate smokers outside in our private garden.
